name: Clicklastica
author: DigiDepot

sections.description:
Clicklastica is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps discourage casual copying of website content.

It silently blocks common actions used to copy text and images without displaying annoying popup messages. The plugin works automatically after activation and requires no configuration.

Clicklastica is designed to be simple, lightweight, and compatible with most WordPress themes and plugins.

Features

  • Disable right-click context menu
  • Block common keyboard shortcuts including F12
  • Disable Ctrl+C, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+S and Ctrl+X
  • Disable drag and drop
  • Disable text selection
  • Improved mobile image protection for long press and image dragging
  • Silent protection with no popup messages
  • No settings required
  • Frontend only
  • Automatically bypasses administrators
  • Supports bypass for selected logged-in user roles
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Protection is enabled automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this completely prevent content theft?

No. Like all content protection plugins, Clicklastica helps discourage casual copying but cannot stop determined users.

Does it affect administrators?

No. Administrators are automatically excluded so they can continue editing and managing the website normally.

Can I allow other user roles to bypass protection?

Yes. In addition to administrators, you can choose which logged-in user roles are excluded from content protection.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. Clicklastica includes protection for Android devices and touchscreen browsers. Protection on Apple Safari may vary because of browser limitations.
